{{Quote|They were mighty warriors, brutal star barbarians that move from planet to planet, demanding tribute and subduing entire populations in their wake.|Parella Jiramma Baco, on the Gorach|<ref name="Hunting the Gorach">{{InsiderCite|133|Hunting the Gorach}}</ref>}}
The '''Gorach''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Gorach were brutal warriors that were strong and quick. They had wide [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and four [[Limb/Legends|arms]] on the broad torsos, which were covered with [[Color/Legends|brown]]-colored hair. Stories of the Gorach claimed that the beings [[Immortality/Legends|did not age]] and that they only met their [[Death/Legends|deaths]] via violent means.

==History==
According to a legend, the Gorach [[Gorach ascension|rose to power]] several thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the life of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Parella Jiramma Baco|Parella]], and they traveled between [[Planet/Legends|planets]], subjugating populations and demanding tribute. Eventually, the Gorach conquered dozens of worlds, including the planet [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]], but their empire fell apart after the Gorach became engaged in a civil war and their subject species rebelled against Gorach rule.

A [[Unidentified Gorach artist|Gorach artist]] later lived alone in the swamps of Lowick for several centuries, and it came to be known by the native [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] as a "swamp ape." At some point, the Hutt [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] Parella traveled to Lowick on a quest to bring down the Gorach, and he eventually succeeded at killing the [[Artist/Legends|artist]].
